evidence.observation: O2 ~4.6 ppm at growth start, matching the post-purge baseline of ~3-6 ppm
O2 rose steadily to 26.0 ppm during growth, a roughly 6x increase that points to air ingress
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, so reduced purge flow does not explain the O2 rise
T 750.1 C, at setpoint; heater power stable ~45%
not installed; tube pressure cannot be checked to tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage
